note: All seven images are AI-generated (not stock, not photographs of real products or real warehouses). They are provisional mockup imagery only and must be replaced with real catalog photography or approved renders before launch. Products depict generic, unbranded items and do not represent any real SKU, supplier, or brand.

generator.tool: Codex CLI 0.164.0 (`codex exec`) built-in image_generation feature
generator.auth: existing ChatGPT login; no API key, no paid credits switch
generator.method: Each image generated in an isolated temp working dir (/tmp/bh-gen/<name>) with an explicit instruction to use the built-in image generation tool (not code/SVG/canvas). Generator-side model name and seed are not exposed by the CLI and were not recorded.
generator.license_note: AI-generated output obtained under the user's ChatGPT account terms; no third-party stock or scraped images are used. Confirm OpenAI usage terms permit intended commercial use before production.

post_processing: ImageMagick: resized (hero 1600x900, others 1200x900), metadata stripped, progressive JPEG (quality 78-80). No other edits.
known_limitations: Packshot backgrounds are close to but not exactly #ECEAE4; measured corner sample of fasteners.jpg is about #E5E2DD due to soft vignette/lighting.
electrical.jpg shows a UK-style (BS 1363) socket faceplate, which is region-specific.
Generated imagery may contain minor physical-detail inaccuracies (thread forms, fittings geometry); do not use as technical reference.
hero.jpg is a synthetic warehouse/workbench scene, not an authentic documentary photograph.
